See https://mail.openjdk.java.net/pipermail/macosx-port-dev/2012-November/005148.html for the reason why we don't follow developer.apple.com/library/mac/#technotes/tn2002/tn2110.
This is looking for javac, tools.jar, etc. Tries JDK_HOME first, then the more common but likely jre JAVA_HOME, and finally the system property based javaHome.
